thread:
Maya Bennett: Quick heads-up: I want us to tighten how errors are surfaced so routing rules, quota UX, and SDKs have a single source of truth. Two constraints: keep HTTP surface stable, and make console badges actionable. Quick takes?
Kevin Liu: Prefer not to add new status codes. Use a small response header + structured body subcode. That keeps existing infra happy.
Sasha Ortiz: Agreed. Headers are easiest for routers. But the console needs a fixed set of buckets (not a flood of freeform strings). We should publish an ontology file that maps subcodes -> bucket.
Ravi Patel: Customer feedback: everything comes back as 429 and they spam retries. We need to distinguish: transient throttle (retry), quota exhaustion (needs admin), and policy denial (no retry).
Ana Gf3mez: Console product ask: expose 3 UX states only: Retryable, Action Required, and Degraded. UX should show one primary badge per route. Can we map subcodes to those three?
Kevin Liu: Draft mapping idea: keep 429 for transient client throttles, 403 for hard policy denies, 503 for platform-level degradations. Add header X-RW-Subcode with small tokens: rate.limit, quota.exhausted, policy.denied, degrade.fallback. Body can include minimal JSON: {"subcode":"...","retryable":true,"runbook":"..."} — but keep body small.
Maya Bennett: Two questions: a) If a request is served by a lower-cap model intentionally (graceful degrade), should that be a 200 with a flag or a 503? b) How will telemetry tag these so console charts can slice by failure mode?
Sasha Ortiz: For (a) prefer 200 + field `degraded: true` and `degraded_model: "<id>"`. It's not an error. For missing responses where we intentionally fallback to a stub, 503 + subcode degrade.fallback. For (b) emit a structured event `routing.decision` with keys: subcode, decision, target_model, source_route, tenant_id.
Ravi Patel: Telemetry ask: make subcode appear as a dimension in both traces and metrics. Emit counters requests.subcode.<subcode> and histograms latency.subcode.<subcode>. Then console can make panels by subcode.
Ana Gf3mez: Badging colors: Retryable -> orange, Action Required -> red, Degraded -> amber. Tooltip should list canonical subcodes and link to runbook. During rollouts we want an overlay showing rollout config + live rate of each subcode.
Kevin Liu: Implementation notes: create an infra-hosted `error_catalog.v1.json` that enumerates subcodes and attributes: badge, retryable, i18n_key, runbook_url. Example entry: {"quota.exhausted":{"retryable":false,"badge":"Action Required","i18n_key":"errors.quota.exhausted","runbook":"/runbooks/quota"}}. Keep keys compact.
Maya Bennett: We must avoid long header values. Header should carry only the subcode token. Clients read the body for runbook URL and human message if needed (i18n key only).
Sasha Ortiz: SDK behavior: default auto-retry for subcodes marked retryable with exponential backoff up to 3 attempts. For non-retryable, surface typed error `RedwoodQuotaError` etc and include `runbook` link in error metadata.
Ravi Patel: Ops: make sure every routed decision emits `routing.decision` and we sample full traces when subcode == quota.exhausted or policy.denied. Add an alert on spikes of `requests.subcode.quota.exhausted`.
Ana Gf3mez: UX edge: during staged rollouts we intentionally route to a new region which might produce route.mismatch. Can console show both the active rollout rule and the subcode rate so PMs can pivot fast?
Kevin Liu: Yes — telemetry should include `rollout_id` when decision is influenced by rollout. The dashboard can overlay that.
Maya Bennett: Action items: 1) Sasha to draft the spec + error_catalog v1, 2) Ravi to add telemetry schema + alert rules, 3) Kevin to update SDK retry logic and error classes, 4) Ana to design console badges + rollout overlay. I'll coordinate a review.
Sasha Ortiz: I'll put a draft in the RFC folder and tag owners.
Ravi Patel: I'll open the metrics PR and wire up a draft dashboard.
Kevin Liu: I'll add SDK tests for header parsing and retry policy.
Ana Gf3mez: I'll mock the badge UX and tooltip copy, link to runbooks.
ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfcs/error-subcode-ontology (auto message) :white_check_mark:
Maya Bennett: Thanks all. Let's review Sasha's draft tomorrow during sync. :rocket:
